ValidationRule.description: If Buyout Operation Result = Accept and Approve Transfer type = Buy out then Service Center Result must be Release Letter Received
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Operations_Result__c, "Balance Transfer Processed"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Transfer_Type__c, "Buy Out"), ISCHANGED(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c, "Release Letter Received")), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Case Should be Release Letter Received as it was assigned by Operations Team.
